'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2024 Kharkiv offensive]], [[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***At least 20 people are injured when [[Russia]]n [[airstrike]]s hit a residential building in [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-15-injured-russian-strike-high-rise-ukraines-kharkiv-2024-05-14/ (Reuters)]
***Ukraine pulls back from positions near Lukyantsi and [[Vovchansk]] in [[Kharkiv Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-sees-signs-kharkiv-front-stabilising-warns-buildup-near-sumy-region-2024-05-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Rafah offensive]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[tanks]] enter residential areas of [[Rafah]] as they attempt to capture the city. [[Hamas]]' armed wing [[al-Qassam Brigades]] says that it destroyed an Israeli troop carrier with a [[Al-Yassin 105]] [[Anti-tank warfare|anti-tank missile]], killing several troops and injuring several others, while the Israel Defense Forces claim to have "eliminated" several terrorists in the city. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-tanks-push-into-gazas-rafah-displaced-civilians-flee-again-2024-05-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli settler violence]]
**[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Israel]]i protestors attack a convoy of [[humanitarian aid|aid]] trucks in [[the West Bank]], damaging 15 trucks and causing $2 million worth of damage. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/palestinian-truckers-fear-safety-after-aid-convoy-gaza-wrecked-2024-05-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**One civilian killed and five IDF personnel injured in Hezbollah shelling on [[Adamit|Adamit kibbutz]] and launches 60 rockets at IDF air traffic control base in [[Mount Meron]], Israel.[https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1413690/strikes-and-fighting-across-gaza-mass-flight-from-rafah-day-221-of-the-gaza-war.html (L'Orient le Jour)]
**Two Hezbollah militants and [[Hussein Makki]], a field commander killed and one injured in Israeli airstrikes on [[Meiss Ej Jabal]] and [[Tyre Lebanon]].[https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2024-05-14/ty-article-live/u-s-germany-slam-right-wing-israelis-attack-on-gaza-bound-aid-convoy/0000018f-74c8-dd07-adbf-fffa73560000 (Haaretz)] 
*[[2024 New Caledonia unrest]]
**[[Riot]]s erupt in [[New Caledonia]] as [[France]] plans to change the constitution, allowing more recent white French settlers to vote in the island's provincial elections, which protesters claim would marginalise the Indigenous [[Kanak people]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/15/france-backs-controversial-new-caledonia-vote-changes-amid-continued-unrest (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/may/14/new-caledonia-curfew-noumea-violence-protests-constitution-change (''The Guardian'')]
**Three Kanak residents are killed and many more injured during a [[drive-by shooting]] by a group of French settlers. [https://www.1news.co.nz/2024/05/15/three-dead-in-new-caledonia-amid-violent-unrest-reports/ (Reuters)] 
**At least 54 officers are injured and more than 130 people are arrested. Shops and cars are [[looting|looted]], while a [[prison breakout]] has been prevented. [https://apnews.com/article/new-caledonia-france-pacific-unrest-police-95f520e93520ac422d6cdda296dbc8d1 (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/15/france-backs-controversial-new-caledonia-vote-changes-amid-continued-unrest (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[2024 Cannes Film Festival|77th annual Cannes Film Festival]] opens in [[Cannes]], [[France]], with [[Meryl Streep]] receiving an honorary [[Palme d'Or]] award. [https://apnews.com/article/cannes-film-festival-greta-gerwig-meryl-streep-650243306d8e6fb23b76e55f8e452c6c (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] passes tariff increases on [[China|Chinese]] imports, including [[electric vehicle]]s and [[electric vehicle battery|batteries]], [[computer chip]]s, and medical products. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/biden-sharply-hikes-us-tariffs-billions-chinese-chips-cars-2024-05-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Economy of Argentina]]
**Inflation in [[Argentina]] slows to a single digit number of 8.8 percent amid severe austerity plans by president [[Javier Milei]]. [https://apnews.com/article/argentina-inflation-milei-single-digits-3cf0adca2cdf911fb04a06c3e9c6880d (AP)]
*[[GameStop short squeeze]]
**The share price of [[GameStop]] increases by a further 61%. [https://qz.com/gamestop-short-sellers-have-lost-more-than-2-billion-i-1851476435 (Quartz)] [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/gamestop-stock-gains-more-than-60-as-meme-stock-market-returns-with-a-vengeance-113640515.html (Yahoo! News)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The death toll from a building collapse in [[George, South Africa|George]], [[South Africa]], last week, increases to 33. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/death-toll-south-african-building-collapse-rises-33-2024-05-14/ (Reuters)]
*Thirteen people, including former Congressman [[Édgar Alarcón]], are killed in a bus crash in [[Vinchos District|Vinchos]], [[Huamanga Province]], [[Peru]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-police-report-13-dead-andean-highway-crash-2024-05-14/ (Reuters)] [https://www.infobae.com/peru/2024/05/14/accidente-en-ayacucho-fallecidos-heridos-empresa-viva-via-libertadores-edgar-alarcon-sufren-videos-fotos/ (Infobae)] 
*Eight people are killed and 40 others are injured when a bus carrying [[farmworkers]] collides with a truck and overturns in [[Marion County, Florida|Marion County]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bus-accident-florida-fatalities-e9693eb05f1f920cb20b166413d91d79 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Russia]]
**[[Russia]]n police arrest former head of personnel of the [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Ministry of Defence]] {{ill|Yuri Vasilievich Kuznetsov|ru|Кузнецов, Юрий Васильевич (военачальник)}} for [[bribery]] of over $1 million. Kuznetsov's charges carry up to 15 years of jail time. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/14/russian-corruption-probe-widens-as-senior-defence-official-arrested (Al Jazeera)]
*Two prison guards are killed and three others are critically injured in an [[ambush]] of a prison van near [[Rouen]], [[Normandy (administrative region)|Normandy]], [[France]], to free an inmate with ties to a drug dealing gang. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-69008577 (BBC News)]
*[[Tunisia]]n police raid the headquarters of the [[Tunisian Order of Lawyers]] in [[Tunis]] and arrest Mahdi Zagrouba, who is known for his opposition to [[President of Tunisia|President]] [[Kais Saied]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/14/tunisian-police-arrest-lawyer-in-new-raid-on-bar-association-headquarters (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Kazakhstan]] sentences former [[Ministry of National Economy (Kazakhstan)|Minister of National Economy]] [[Kuandyk Bishimbayev]] to 24 years in prison for [[torturing]] and murdering his wife. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/14/kazakhstan-jails-former-minister-for-24-years-over-wifes-torture-murder (Al Jazeera)]
*Russian dissident [[Vladimir Kara-Murza]] loses his appeal against a 25-year prison sentence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kremlin-critic-kara-murza-loses-his-appeal-against-treason-sentence-2024-05-14/ (Reuters)]
*A court in [[Germany]] convicts and fines [[Alternative for Germany]] member [[Björn Höcke]] [[Euro|€]]13,000 ($14,000) for using a [[Nazi]] slogan that once belonged to the [[Sturmabteilung]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/14/court-convicts-german-far-right-figure-bjorn-hocke-for-using-nazi-slogan (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023–2024 Georgian protests]]
**Riot police clash with protesters on the streets of [[Tbilisi]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], after the [[Parliament of Georgia|parliament]] approves a controversial "foreign agent" law that requires media organizations to declare foreign funding. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-europe-69010885 (BBC News)]
**The [[United States]] warns Georgia that [[US$|$]]390 million in planned economic support will be "under review" if the [[Government of Georgia (country)|Georgian government]] considers the U.S. as an "adversary", and not as a strategic partner. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/may/14/us-warns-georgia-not-to-side-with-moscow-against-the-west (''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[May 2024 solar storms]]
**The [[sun]] emits the largest [[solar flare]] since 2005, days after producing auroras in the [[Northern Hemisphere|Northern]] and [[Southern Hemisphere|Southern Hempisheres]]. [https://www.axios.com/2024/05/15/sun-solar-largest-flare-solar-cycle-auroras (Axios)]
*[[Russia]] places its nuclear capable submarine-launched [[RSM-56 Bulava|Bulava intercontinental ballistic missile]] into service. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-puts-submarine-launched-bulava-intercontinental-missile-into-service-2024-05-14/ (Reuters)]
